Negative settled ETF flows reinforce caution but are not current-session flow evidence. Broad altcoin transmission is not confirmed; relatively resilient Top-100 tail assets do not establish rotation or microcap participation. The structural prior is context only, and no recovery schedule is adopted. These are descriptive, non-binding forecasts with no portfolio execution authority.
